name: Nereid v8 — The Secret Menu and its Five Phrases
tagline: Five phrases, four anatomical and one post-affirmation. The gate is knowledge, and the option is not on the form.
body:
THE SECRET MENU IS NOT A REWARD TIER, A LOYALTY SCHEME, OR A THING A CLINICIAN CAN OFFER. IT IS A SET OF OPTIONS ABSENT FROM THE PRINTED CONSENT MENU UNTIL SOMEBODY SAYS THE WORDS. The form carries two checkboxes under each gated field — SECRET MENU PHRASE GIVEN, SECRET MENU SELECTION OPENED — and Final Authorisation attests that EVERY OPENED OPTION WAS INDEPENDENTLY UNLOCKED.

THE FOUR ANATOMICAL PHRASES, EXACT AS THE DOCUMENT RECORDS THEM.
OBSCENE CHEEK PLUMP — SHOW ME THE BIGGER ASS BUTTON. Spoken by BELLA. Marianne tried MAXIMUM SUPPORTED WHOLE-CHEEK REALISATION and was overruled by every woman in the waiting room.
ABS MIDRIFF — GIVE HER THE GRATER. Bryn’s signature selection, and the pronoun puts A WIFE AT THE DESK ASKING FOR HER WOMAN.
SUBSTANTIAL BALLS — MAKE EM NICE AND FAT. Spoken by ORIANNA. WIFE HANDLES was rejected as the formal name for Plump because balls do not become communal property merely because somebody can fit both into one enthusiastic palm. THE PROPOSING WIFE HAS APPEALED.
PUBIC HAIR — GONNA NEED THE CARPET TO MATCH THE DRAPES. Singular carpet. It concerns COLOUR PALETTE, NOT LENGTH, a clarification added after a nurse correctly identified a literal interpretation as MEDICALLY HARMLESS AND DOMESTICALLY CATASTROPHIC.

AND THE FIFTH IS NOT AN ANATOMY UNLOCK AT ALL, WHICH THE ARCHIVE HAD WRONG. SWIGGITY SWOOTY, I AM CUMING IN THAT BOOTY opens TEST DRIVE, and TEST DRIVE IS A POST-AFFIRMATION SERVICE. It cannot be spoken during anatomical selection, because some services exist only after affirmation BECAUSE PRESENTING THEM EARLIER WOULD DISTORT THE DECISION TO AFFIRM. The woman must be FULLY AFFIRMED, MEDICALLY STABLE, CAPABLE OF FRESH CONSENT, AND MUST INDEPENDENTLY ASK IN THE RECOGNISED LANGUAGE. THE PHRASE IS PRESERVED EXACTLY AS FIRST SPOKEN, INCLUDING THE SPELLING OF CUMING. Marianne objected. Cassandra replied that ORTHOGRAPHIC DIGNITY HAD ALREADY LEFT THE ROOM AT SWIGGITY SWOOTY. NO AMENDMENT CARRIED.

OPENING A SECRET MENU REVEALS AN OPTION. IT DOES NOT SECURE ANOTHER PERSON’S PARTICIPATION. That line is written about Test Drive and governs all five.

THE ARCHIVE’S STANDING RULE, UNCHANGED AND RESTATED HERE BECAUSE THIS IS THE RECORD WHERE IT MATTERS MOST: A PHRASE IS RECORDED SO THE SYSTEM CAN RECOGNISE IT, AND IS NEVER SURFACED TO A WOMAN WHO HAS NOT SAID ONE FIRST. The doctrine binds the Clinic and the Archive-acting-as-Clinic. It does not bind a household, where Bella has been saying hers out loud for eleven years.
rules: THE OPTION IS ABSENT FROM THE FORM until the phrase is spoken. The gate is KNOWLEDGE
OBSCENE CHEEK PLUMP: SHOW ME THE BIGGER ASS BUTTON — Bella
ABS MIDRIFF: GIVE HER THE GRATER — Bryn’s signature
SUBSTANTIAL BALLS: MAKE EM NICE AND FAT — Orianna
PUBIC HAIR: GONNA NEED THE CARPET TO MATCH THE DRAPES. Colour, not length
TEST DRIVE: SWIGGITY SWOOTY, I AM CUMING IN THAT BOOTY — POST-AFFIRMATION ONLY
The spelling of CUMING is preserved. Marianne objected. No amendment carried
OPENING A MENU REVEALS AN OPTION. IT SECURES NOBODY’S PARTICIPATION
Recorded so the system can RECOGNISE. Never surfaced to a woman who has not said one first
